subject: Mac installed ai-kit moves to merged main 3ee08a90; gateway restarts once
result: Installing ai-kit candidate 3ee08a90 (main: contains the earlier joined cut e8caad2f: main 5a0690f2 plus gateway-ops, now merged) with oi update, then restarting the Mac gateway onto it. Omarchy already runs it. Expect the new aikit and one gateway restart; Communiques persist; the firewall may queue inbound peers until macOS lists the new binary (doctor names the owner command). Rollback: oi update --rollback or aikit gateway upgrade rollback ID.
